status: Native independent references; no C++ execution and no production-generated expected values.

supplemental_boost.scope: Locally inspected implementation evidence only; not pinned OpenMS source and not proof that upstream goldens were produced by this Boost version. Private RNG oracles and their packaged generator are recorded in rng_reference.

extraction: Original expected uppercase strings copied from the numbered source assertion lines. Thirteen unique cases cover fifteen assertions because variant zero appears twice for TESTPEPTIDE and the top-down sequence. No shuffling/RNG or C++ implementation was executed to create this fixture.
stateful_order: One object starts at seed 4711; three shuffle_peptides rows execute in order 1,2,3 without resetting RNG or cache. Earlier reversal calls do not change that state. Cached IDE from call 2 is reused in call 3. Outer shuffle rows use that same receiver but source creates a fresh seed 4711+variant per digested peptide and ignores receiver seed/cache.

derived_cases.cross_context: Fresh seed 4711 on isolated TESTRPEPTR with no cleavage is equivalent to the outer shuffle Trypsin first product. ETEPTSRRTP is its ten-letter prefix from source golden ETEPTSRRTPDIE. Caching it and then using TESTRPEPTRIDE/Trypsin with zero attempts gives ETEPTSRRTPIDE. This is a deduction from the algorithm and source outer golden, not an additional literal assertion.
derived_cases.reversal: AK/Trypsin -> KA; ACDPEFDGK/Asp-N -> ACEPDFKGD; ABC/unspecific cleavage -> ABCABBCCBA. These are hand-derived from explicit cuts and source last-letter/final-product rules.
derived_cases.unspecific_zero_attempts: ABC products A,B,C,AB,BC,ABC concatenate to ABCABBCABC when attempts are zero. Outer shuffle shortcuts products of length at most 2 and redigests ABC; output length is 17 with prefix ABCABBCABCABBC, followed by a permutation of ABC.
derived_cases.short_state: AG/no cleavage has no candidate better than target/reverse under the max-identity objective. Direct 100-attempt shuffling returns AG but consumes 100 bounded draws; zero attempts stores the same cache without draws. AKR/Trypsin has only singleton shuffled ranges and consumes no draws even with 100 attempts.
derived_cases.empty: Reverse whole empty is empty; source peptide methods index a nonexistent final product and native must error. Outer positive factor returns that many empty outputs; factor zero returns none.
derived_cases.modified: All transformations enforce source !isModified precondition, including numeric/terminal modifications; header discard-modifications wording is not substituted for the implementation.

comparison: All sequence strings and state equality checks are exact. Mathematical shape/permutation assertions do not claim a particular unobserved RNG output.

generator.output: JSON on stdout; no file writes or dependencies beyond the Python standard library.

coverage: Three seeds over four complete twist cycles, with checkpoints and whole-output checksums.
Primary-source 10000th-word literal for the standard default seed.
Clone/reseed state preservation and seed extrema.
Descending Fisher-Yates permutations and exact state/draw counts.
Zero-draw empty/singleton slices and zero-width inclusive range.
Bucket boundaries, full-width range, and division-versus-modulo discrimination.
Forced rejection consumes one draw; failed precharge does not advance state.
Private partial progress and public caller staging contract.
Boost redundant-bit normalization and all-zero-state repair.

rng_reference.method: Derived Python exact-integer append-only MT19937-64 recurrence with 64-bit initialization and literal tempering masks, independent of the native cyclic in-place twist. The initial word's redundant low 31 bits are replaced before use, so the output oracle omits Boost's normalization; native state tests check normalization separately. No C++, Boost binary or native production algorithm generates these expected values.

checksum.byte_encoding: All 1248 raw u64 words as consecutive little-endian bytes.
checksum.arithmetic: XOR each byte, multiply by the prime, reduce modulo 2^64.

rng_reference.shuffle_mapping: Descending Fisher-Yates. For each inclusive [0,high], divide a raw word by floor(2^64/(high+1)); accept quotient<=high, otherwise consume another word. Range high=0 uses no word.
rng_reference.artifact_policy: The Rust test constants and generator output retain all checkpoint values; no duplicate JSON fixture is required. Per-seed raw words, checksums, and shuffle permutations are derived references, distinct from the literal standard and OpenMS class-test assertions.
